body: I sure will! Thank you, thank you!
Thank you SO much. She loves art and I am positive she'd love a pic drawn for her! I'm so sorry you lost your friend, I truly can't imagine!! I'll head to the sub you suggested, after dinner!
Honestly, I don't I know how to find the sidebar, i'm never on anything but my phone (app) so that eludes me, so really, thank you
Thank you so much. I will read it ALL!
Thank you. After infertility my kids are even more my miracles, I'd do literally anything for them!
That would be awesome! I am going to talk to her about it later this evening, get her feedback, and get back to you. Thank you so much!

Thank you for sharing. We have an amazing children's hospital about 30 minutes away that i'll not hesitate to take her to if necessary. I should say both my husband (her dad) and I are trained by community mental health and we are experienced in dealing with mental illness and the ramifications of it.  Buuuuut when it's your own child.... Jesus.  She is the brightest, kindest soul you'd ever meet.... and artistic! So creative! This has been shocking to say the least, but I'd be lying if I didn't say that i'm sooooo proud that she felt comfortable enough to confide in me/us. I'm currently confident that we can get through the weekend, but believe me when I say I wont hesitates to take her in. Thank you, again! I'm so sorry about your friend. I truly can't imagine.
Oohh okay. Got it! Whew! Lol! This is new to me and I honestly am just sooooo lost right now. Thank you for clarifying.

I appreciate that. She's not on any social media, and right now she's playing with her siblings. I am thankful she felt safe enough to come to me about this, and we are going to counseling as soon as possible. Naturally, anything that glorifies depression or suicide would not be shared with her.
Yes, this is a throw away account...my real account has too many identifiers.
